summary: RETEST PASSED: Phone normalization fix verified end-to-end. All 28/28 backend pytest cases pass (100%), including AI description generation (Emergent LLM budget appears restored in this run). Backend: verify-otp accepts both bare '9999999999' AND '+919999999999' and returns the seeded admin (role=admin); same for owner (+919111111111 -> role=owner) and buyer (+919222222222 -> role=buyer). Owner property creation returns status=pending and is retrievable via /api/properties/mine. Admin /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/properties?status=pending work. Frontend: login as 9999999999 via UI now lands on tabs home as 'Ghar Admin' with ADMIN badge; Profile tab shows 'Admin Panel' button; tapping it navigates to /admin which renders stats (11 users, 4 owners, 8 properties, 6 rent, 2 sale) and pending/approved/rejected property tabs. Home tab shows Featured + Latest sections with property cards including seeded + created-in-test properties. Deprecated Expo/RN style warnings persist (shadow* and pointerEvents) - not a functional blocker.

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to the boxShadow API across StyleSheet definitions in /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src.
Console deprecation: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents from JSX props to style objects wherever used.

action_items: (Non-blocking cleanup) Migrate deprecated React Native props: shadow* style props -> boxShadow, and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents across the app.
(Nice-to-have) Consider marking /api/ai/generate-description with a graceful fallback message if Emergent LLM budget is 0 in future environments (currently works but was flaky in iteration_1).
critical_code_review_comments: _normalize_phone in server.py correctly canonicalizes to +91XXXXXXXXXX for both bare and +91-prefixed inputs; seed also uses +91-prefixed phones; migration path to upgrade legacy admin to role=admin is in place - solid fix.
PUT /api/properties/{id} still resets status to 'pending' after any edit (including by admin) - acceptable if intended, otherwise consider preserving status for admin edits.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (fixed test-only bug: NEW_BUYER_PHONE was generated from uuid hex containing non-digit chars, causing normalizer to reject it; now uses random digits only)

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (admin login -> Profile -> Admin Panel -> stats render). Wishlist/visit UI flows not re-tested this iteration since backend equivalents (Wishlist/Visits/Chat pytest classes) pass.

seed_data_creation: During pytest run: 1 test property (TEST Sample Property -> TEST Updated Title, Bengaluru, rent 35000) created via owner API and approved+featured by admin. 1 disposable buyer user created via mock OTP with random 10-digit phone. Cumulative from iteration_1 the DB now has ~11 users and ~8 properties.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All RETEST items from iteration_1 are green. Phone normalization + admin/owner/buyer seed roles work for both bare and +91 formats. Admin UI flow (login 9999999999 -> Profile -> Admin Panel) works. Only remaining items are cosmetic RN deprecation warnings. If further UI depth needed, cover: wishlist add/remove on Home & Search cards, Saved tab reflection, Property detail sticky CTA (Call/Chat/Schedule Visit) modal submission - backend equivalents all pass, so a light UI smoke should suffice.
rca_of_issue: N/A - previous iteration_1 bug (phone-format mismatch causing seeded admin/owner/buyer to be unreachable via the UI) is now fixed. Root cause was exact-match phone lookup vs. differing storage/input formats. Fix implemented in server.py::_normalize_phone (strips non-digits, handles 91 country-code, produces canonical +91XXXXXXXXXX) and seeding now uses +91-prefixed phones with a migration to upgrade legacy admin. Verified via both pytest and live curl for +91-prefixed variant.
